verdict.rationale: GoDaddy provides machine-readable OpenAPI specs, an llms.txt index, and code examples in curl/Node/Python/Go plus CLI/MCP snippets, giving an AI-native user structured, copy-runnable references. However, there's no evidence of an interactive in-browser 'try it now' console (e.g., Swagger UI) where examples can be executed live from the docs. missing for 10: an in-browser interactive try-it console, evidence of live example execution, independent confirmation of interactivity beyond static code snippets.
